note: Language -> {build, launch, status, mldsa} table for the N-AALP conformance adapters. 'wired' adapters build and pass the corpus in CI now; 'planned' adapters + their SDKs are built and graded under task #20. 'mldsa' records the deterministic FIPS 204 (rnd=0) library the SDK uses, or 'to-verify' until researched this session (C4/E8). An SDK with no deterministic ML-DSA returns skipped for mldsa.keygen/cose.sign1/cose.verify1 and is graded on every pure op; the gap is tracked here, never green-washed.

php.launch: php -d extension=ffi -d ffi.enable=1 -d extension=sodium -d extension=intl harness/adapters/php/adapter.php
php.mldsa: full via PHP-FFI to OpenSSL >= 3.5: deterministic (rnd=0) ML-DSA-65/87 keygen-from-seed/sign/verify, byte-identical to the FIPS 204 consensus (proven vs dilithium-py). Grades all pure ops + Ed25519 + mldsa.keygen/cose.sign1/cose.verify1 where OpenSSL >= 3.5 is reachable; honestly skip-tracks ML-DSA where the runtime OpenSSL is older (never a false green)

ruby.mldsa: platform OpenSSL >= 3.5 (key.sign deterministic=1 = FIPS 204 rnd=0; seed->pk via PKCS#8); verified byte-identical on OpenSSL 3.6. Gracefully skips ML-DSA where OpenSSL < 3.5 (e.g. older CI runners)

swift.graded: 315 graded, 2 skip-tracked (forkproof.preimage/body, shared across all ports); full crypto incl. deterministic ML-DSA-65/87 + LAMPS composite. Graded in CI run 32097712833 (swift:6.1 container); also builds+tests on Swift 6.3.3
swift.mldsa: swift-crypto 4.5.1 vendored BoringSSL — keygen-from-seed + verify via the public MLDSA65/MLDSA87 API; deterministic (rnd=0) signing via the CNaalpMldsa C shim reaching BoringSSL's internal BCM_mldsa{65,87}_sign_internal (the public swift-crypto signer is hedged-only). Byte-identical to the FIPS-204 / composite consensus (composite value ML-DSA leg ef8aa0a1..). swift-crypto pinned .exact("4.5.1") because the shim reaches an internal symbol; the composite KAT is the canary on any bump.
